booking.source: No recreation.gov / RIDB facility exists for Coffee Pot Spring (RIDB search 'coffee pot', 2026-10-28: only Upper Coffee Pot ID and a trail), so under the phase-7 rule a federal campground with no recreation.gov listing is first-come only.

sites.source: No Forest Service page describes the campground (it is absent from the White River NF campground list and its 2026 operating-dates table, read 2026-10-28). The stored 10 sites / 30 ft were derived from note prose that rests only on directory listings, and ParkAdvisor gives 'Max RV Length: 20 ft', so both are cleared.

facilities.source: Same as sites: no FS page for the campground (the Coffee Pot - Deep Lake Area page's 'Vault Toilet' / no-water entries describe the winter snowmobile area, whose point 39.6778,-107.0967 is ~9 km east of the campground). The derived values rested on directory-based note prose and are cleared. Read 2026-10-28.

note: Small USFS campground on a south-facing aspen/spruce slope at about 10,100 ft, roughly 16 miles up Coffee Pot Road (FDR 600) from the Dotsero exit off I-70. Sites have level gravel driveways that accommodate RVs/trailers up to about 30 ft; picnic tables, fire rings. Access is via a long, narrow one-lane gravel road (drive slowly), but it is passable for a 23-ft rig. Season roughly mid-summer through early fall. --Claude
summary: No campground page exists: the stored website is the Coffee Pot - Deep Lake winter snowmobiling area page, and Coffee Pot Spring is missing from the White River NF's 52-campground list and from its 2026 Campground Operating Dates table (which lists Sweetwater and Deep Lake, both on FDR 600). No recreation.gov facility either, so booking set first-come only by the no-listing rule. Cleared directory-derived site count (10), max length (30) and toilet/water values. Imagery shows a small loop road at the pin in aspen above a meadow; pin OK. Note trimmed of 'FCFS, no reservations' and the toilet/water line.
flags: CRITERIA / possible closure: Coffee Pot Spring Campground is not on the White River NF's own list of its 52 developed campgrounds (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/camping-cabins) nor in the forest's '2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates' table (https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354), which does list the other FDR 600 campgrounds (Sweetwater CG 10/20' $8; Deep Lake CG 34/36' $6). No recreation.gov facility. Campendium now lists it as 'Coffee Pot Spring Dispersed Camping' with a reviewer reporting it closed around October 2020. The loop still shows on imagery. No agency page designates it as a campground today - a human call (curation doc: an entry with no agency page is a flag).

Website: the stored link https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/coffee-pot-deep-lake-area is a winter snowmobiling area page ('Coffee Pot Road #600 opens a large portion of the Deep Creek region to the snowmobiler in winter months'), not the campground's. No campground page was found.

Fees: the stored $0 (fees provenance 2026-10-09) quotes that snowmobile-area page's 'No fees are required for this site', which is about the winter area, not the campground. Left alone (not a derived value); the forest's 2026 table gives no fee for Coffee Pot Spring because it does not list it.
Missing phone: the area page gives the Eagle-Holy Cross Ranger District, 970-827-5715 (24747 US Highway 24, Minturn).

Rig length: directories disagree (ParkAdvisor 'Max RV Length: 20 ft'; the note's ~30 ft). No agency figure. No 4WD or high-clearance advice for FDR 600 was found on the FS pages read (Deep Lake's directions: 'turn left onto Coffee Pot Springs Rd., FDR 600. Follow this road for 29 miles').
